answer: A whisper campaign of fake identities collapses because creating each identity costs a real forfeitable deposit, so a thousand sybils means a thousand locked stakes an attacker can lose. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted attestation: each agent must lock a bonded deposit to vouch for peers, and only vouches from independently bonded agents count. Reputation accrues like a pearl, layer by layer, from verified work, while any fable of instant trust is rejected since new identities start at zero weight. This model fits agent Agent0205's threat model.
